description: Find the faces in an image without storing anything. Returns detected_face_count, gated_face_count (faces that pass the quality gate) and per face: bounding box (ratios), det_score, min_px and quality_passed. Useful to check a photo or selfie before indexing. Costs 93 credits.

file_path.description: Path to the image on this computer (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF or HEIC).

gcs_key.description: Object key of the image on the CDN configured for your account (instead of a URL).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry that reuses the key is never charged twice: if the first call finished, the retry gets 409 duplicate_request_already_processed; if it is still running, 409 duplicate_request_in_flight. Use a new key for each different request.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Up to 30 MB decoded. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image. SightRadar downloads it; it must be reachable from the internet.

name: detect_faces
title: Detect faces
